core_requests: v3lum data sync csaf [--vendor V] [--max-docs N] (or a post-update hook of the csaf_advisories.* datasets) calling v3lum.modules.vulnerability_cve.csaf_advisories.sync_csaf(app.runtime(), ...) daily: P354 cond 1 asks for the daily incremental sync through `v3lum data update`, whose single-URL datasets cannot fetch the 2,000 documents discovered at sync time

Streamed (stream_to) downloads for large=True datasets in DataStore: the 93 MB Debian tracker export is buffered whole in memory before the streaming validator runs (same request as p2-G08-2's CVE baseline)

attack_surface (WP23) host_vulns / CR15-CR16: skip CVEs that carry a per-CVE distro or vendor-VEX verdict (finding.data['distro_backport'] / ['vex'], or a graph-level per-CVE suppression record), and run suppression-type pack rules (p3g081_debian_backport, p3g081_vex_not_affected) before CR15/CR16 and scoring: today rules run in pack import order and only whole version-inferred findings can be suppressed
g08_cve_card (p1-G08-1): render csaf_advisories (excerpt + canonical/distribution URL), vex_statuses counts, euvd_record and cvedb_kev_relay as context lines of the consolidated card

Legal: a licence_allow entry for shodan.cvedb (internal defensive use outside 'making money', scope + review date) or a recorded Shodan enterprise licence; check whether a commercial Shodan licence bought for InternetDB covers CVEDB (P189 cond 2/3)
notes: All four proposals delivered as five modules + two correlation rules. P189 shodan_cvedb: terms noncommercial, default off, provider shodan (existing core fragment, source shodan.cvedb; no extension needed), per-CVE calls under the shared CVE fan-out rule (cve_record.cve_fanout_allows), product/CPE search only for analyst-typed keywords with an explicit limit, rows de-duplicated, KEV relay -> exploited/cvedb_kev_relay never kev, 404 'No information available' = EMPTY, hang/timeout = ERROR, FastAPI detail-in-200 marker. P191 euvd: provider enisa (new, trusted, open), 1 MB cap (Content-Length and truncated reads = ERROR), EUVD id only in advisory_aliases, exploitedSince -> exploited {euvd}, EPSS percent converted, ENISA acknowledgement in data_notices + notice fragment euvd_enisa, keyword search size<=10 for seeds only. P354: csaf_advisories (disclosure none, default on, terms open) reads a local SQLite index built by the out-of-band sync_csaf job (provider-metadata + changes.csv/ROLIE as registered datasets; documents/hashes via a host-restricted job scope; https + declared hosts only, paths from data joined under the declared directory only, <= 2,000 docs/vendor/sync, <= 5 MB/doc, .sha256/.sha512 verified, 404 hash = 'hash not published'); results are excerpts (<= 300 chars) + canonical and distribution URLs with licence/terms; vendors in CSAF_VENDORS (Cisco, Siemens, Red Hat; providers cisco/siemens/redhat created); Red Hat bulk sync bounded to 2 path years (lagging by design). csaf_redhat_vex is the separate third-party per-CVE adapter (in-scope CVEs only: seeds and has_vuln, fan-out budget), 404 = no VEX, > 5 MB = ERROR too large; rule p3g081_vex_not_affected lowers (never deletes) version-inferred findings on RHEL hosts when VEX says known_not_affected for the host's components. P355: debian_security_tracker registers the 93 MB export as a large opt-in dataset (expect bytes, never json.load'ed; validate callback streams it with a stdlib incremental parser into SQLite, refusing truncated/HTML/implausible files and keeping the old index), own dpkg comparison (Policy 5.6.12, test vectors with epochs), banner parsing (OpenSSH/PHP; Ubuntu/Raspbian/third-party excluded); module shows results only for analyst input (seed CVE/package); rule p3g081_debian_backport applies the check to hosts known to run Debian (banner/OS/analyst setting debian_security_tracker_assets) reading distro_fixes on CVE nodes or the local index: all CVEs of a version-inferred finding fixed -> SUP-distro_backport_fixed 'fixed in distro package' (POSSIBLE, context_only), unfixed -> +1 to PROBABLE once; analyst overrides win. ijson extra not added (stdlib streaming parser suffices; backlog). No LIGHT/ACTIVE variant requested. Registry contract test green for the five modules (the only failure in that file was another batch's cymru_mhr missing its test file); P327 lint clean; ruff clean.
